# video37 reconstruction report (round 001)

Representation level: L1 (proxy). Three.js sampled-frame baseline (native inspect-revise protocol); not a Blender-equivalent ranking.

Observed from the 24 reference samples: one continuous shot, no cuts. A woman in a red jacket and a boy in a plaid shirt walk from a large wooden hotel (t=0-1.6 s), start running right, and the camera pans right (about 26 deg of yaw over ~0-7 s) while trucking right along a tall topiary hedge-maze wall at constant height. They pass a bench, lamp posts, a waste bin and a wooden ticket hut, then turn into the arched maze gateway (~13-14.4 s). A roofed wooden map board in the foreground slides in from the right, and the camera decelerates and holds on it (~16.8-18.4 s).

Geometry: hotel as boxes with prism roofs; hedge as wall boxes with box towers and cone tops, a gateway made of pillar and lintel boxes, a darker interior hedge visible through the arch; ground planes for lawn, gravel path, asphalt road and footpath; a flattened sphere hill with sphere tree clusters; benches, bins, lamps, hut, conifers; map board built from posts, a roof, panels and a procedural DataTexture maze poster (no text).
Articulation: both people are hierarchies with pelvis, torso, head, thighs and knees, and shoulders and elbows. The gait phase comes from precomputed arc length, so it is absolute-time deterministic. Walk blends into run by speed, the pelvis height keeps the lowest foot on the ground, and the woman's arms reach forward while she runs.
Camera: a PerspectiveCamera (vertical FOV 29.4 deg) at height 1.5 m, pitched up 3.9 deg. The x position and yaw are monotone-cubic tracks keyed at every sample time, estimated from the image positions of the lamps, hedge towers, hut and hotel chimney.
Timing: the native timeline is time = frame/fps. The people tracks are keyed at the sample times; they are hidden once they are inside the maze behind the board (t > 15.4 s).

Inference vs observation: the positions between samples, the 3D depths (estimated from relative sizes and parallax), the people's paths before and after they become visible, and the maze interior are all inferred.
Feedback: none received yet (initial round). Unverified: lighting intensity semantics, exact framing, and exact hotel layout.
